instruction: A cute stop-motion claymation snail with a fat spiral shell and two curly eye-stalks. Soft matte plasticine surfaces with visible thumb-print dimples and slightly uneven, hand-sculpted edges. Warm pastel clay colors.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE claymation snail in a claymation plasticine stop-motion style. A cute stop-motion claymation snail with a fat spiral shell and two curly eye-stalks. Soft matte plasticine surfaces with visible thumb-print dimples and slightly uneven, hand-sculpted edges. Warm pastel clay colors. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
